summary: Wake 09:30 London, 26 October: one pass of the source watch on the pack vault 7r83qic5, two phases each committed and pushed, vault in sync at head 9987a9519704; first full pass on sgit-ai v0.25.0. Nothing written to v1. dev of team taken in at de709b37d2eb. Performance, sgit-ai 0.24.0 against 0.25.0 on the same vault (79,465 files, 2.7 GB, 38,474 trees), measured from the pass logs and the commands: status 155 s -> 11 s (first, builds the scan cache) and 3.3 s (after); history log more than 8 min -> 9 s; pull 2.3 s (0.24.0 not timed); data export (history log inside it) about 9 min -> 34 s; pass, phase 1 commit 4 min 24 s, 4 min 12 s, 4 min 11 s and 12 min 38 s (0.24.0, four measurements) -> 25 s; phase 1 push 4 min 22 s, 3 min 56 s, 4 min 6 s and 4 min 16 s -> 67 s; phase 2 commit 4 min 43 s -> 4 s; phase 2 push 3 min 46 s -> 16 s; whole pass 57 min and 59 min -> 35 min; unchanged and not sgit: probe of 413 sites 5 min 44 s to 6 min 4 s, watch of about 850 pages 25 min 53 s to 27 min 25 s, discovery under 20 s. Of the 35 minutes, 33 are the probe and the watch, which fetch the web. The detail is in records/agents/researcher/debriefs/2026-10-26__sgit-0-25-0-before-and-after.md.
